title: Rework task system: collision-free IDs under concurrent pushers (kill shared .counter)
description: PROBLEM (observed 2026-06-18): the './task' CLI assigns IDs from a single shared monotonic file '.tasks/.counter'. With multiple independent agents/pushers each rebasing+pushing to main, two creators read the same counter value, mint the same NNNN prefix, and because their slugs differ git merges BOTH files cleanly with NO textual conflict -> duplicate task numbers (e.g. two '1201-*' tasks). The .counter file is also a guaranteed merge hotspot on every concurrent create. GOAL: make task creation safe under N concurrent pushers with no central coordination. APPROACH (implementer decides exact design, justify in task notes): (a) Replace the monotonic NNNN prefix as the UNIQUE KEY with a collision-resistant id -- e.g. a short ULID / time-sortable random suffix / content hash -- so two creators never collide; (b) ELIMINATE .tasks/.counter as a contended shared file (derive list ordering from created_at + priority, not a shared counter); (c) keep IDs human-readable and time-sortable for 'task list' (a creation-timestamp-derived sortable prefix + random disambiguator is acceptable); (d) provide a one-shot migration ('./task migrate') that rewrites existing NNNN-slug tasks to the new scheme WITHOUT losing history, and add duplicate-prefix DETECTION + a repair command; (e) keep all existing CLI subcommands (create/list/show/update/delete/acquire/release/renew) working and their flags stable; (f) ensure 'acquire' locks and the gitignored locks/ dir still work. UPDATE AGENTS.md (Storage layout, Task CLI reference, id format) and any docs/ that describe the 4-digit prefix. DONE = concurrent-create simulation (two processes create many tasks, merge both trees) yields ZERO id collisions; existing tasks migrate cleanly; './task' unit/self-tests (add some if absent) pass; AGENTS.md updated. SEQUENCING: this reformats .tasks/*.json id fields, so it must run AFTER the current in-flight feature wave (1201-1205) has merged, to avoid prohibitive conflicts on those task files. Touches the root './task' script + AGENTS.md + docs only.
